what: Text sits twisted in 3D one letter at a time (e.g. rotated 15° and tilted 35° on the Y axis·25° on the X axis at 1.3×, shifted 15px up·35px right) and transparent, then once it passes the lower 25% of the screen, each letter straightens and appears over 1.5s, .18s apart. Layers inside a letter are rotated the opposite way until they settle at 2.025s. Chunks that enter at the same moment are delayed 1.2s each in order so they settle in turn

options.type: Twist types a·b·c·d (the original four types), default a
options.stagger: Gap between characters (seconds), default .18 (in the original only the fourth chunk is .12)
options.gap: Gap (s) between chunks that came in together, default 1.2
options.margin: Visibility check rootMargin, default ‹0px 0px -25% 0px› (on phones the original is -5%)

use:
Your vertical text here

— Holds up in vertical writing too (writing-mode: vertical-rl)
note: The original uses Motion’s animate (Web Animations) and passes the transform string straight to element.animate

from.where: index.html .sh-kv__tag (four vertical phrases around the oval hero, a·b·c·d)
